test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.**

I hope Mom will have cook all our favourite dishes before we come into the room again.

options.text: I hope Mom will have cook

solution:
The correct answer is: "**I hope Mom will have cook**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error here is related to the use of the verb "**have**" in conjunction with "**cook**."
 
• In this context, it should be "**cooked**," not "cook."
 
• The verb "**have**" is used as an auxiliary verb to form the future perfect tense, which requires the past participle form of the verb "**cook**."
 
• "**Cooked**" is the past participle form, and it is the correct choice in this context to indicate that the action of cooking the dishes will be completed before a future point in time.
 
• The correct sentence should be "*I hope Mom will have cooked all our favourite dishes before we come into the room again.*"

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.
